newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor recovers after fall on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: India castor recovers after fall on short-covering.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices eased on Monday to 1,098/1,099 rupees per quintal from 1,114/1,115 rupees following higher arrivals at the producing centres, dealers said.
But later in the day prices bounced back modestly to 1,101/1,102 rupees per quintal as lower prices attracted light short covering, they said.
"Sentiment is still weak looking at the poor overseas enquiries," one dealer said.
"Foreign buyers are demanding Indian castoroil at $690 per tonne while Indian offers are at 700/705."
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 40,000/45,000 bags (75 kg each).
No trading was reported in the castorseed September delivery due to absence of fresh interest but some traders indicated September delivery at 1,170/1,175 rupees per quintal.
"Groundnut oil moved up from 358/360 rupees to 367/368 rupees per 10 kg on increased seasonal buying while arrivals from summer crop remained lower than expected," one miller said.
Imported palm oil was steady at 287/288 rupees per 10 kg but sentiment was subdued on reports of arrivals of about 6,000 tonnes of imported palm oil at the Bombay port.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by 5/10 rupees to 560/565 rupees per 15 kg.
